summary.executiveSummaryReference: The meeting reviewed software changes for the Eakin technical file, with alarm changes largely completed and language changes underway. Remaining work included mute-button behaviour, clinical review, debug testing, traceability for the 17 historic software changes, and possible retrospective test data. Electrical compliance testing will be completed in-house, while cybersecurity discussion focused on USB-port and GUI controls, including whether physical locks, software controls or benefit-risk rationale are appropriate.
